checkpoints.description: [1/3] Add a browser-only IndexedDB autosave store that captures layer PNG blobs, document metadata and blend/lock/adjustment state after edits, plus a startup restore dialog with Restore and Start fresh choices. [2/3] Wire debounced saves into commits, undo/redo and opened documents, handle quota/corrupt records gracefully, and keep the welcome sample from overwriting an older autosave. [3/3] Add static and browser dogfood coverage including a real page reload and restore, bump Palette to 0.6.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: A local-first editor must survive a reload or crash; IndexedDB recovery closes the last major data-loss gap without adding a server.
impact_assessment.benefits: Automatic local recovery, no uploads, graceful failure, and a restore choice that never replaces the welcome sample silently.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new startup modal and a new browser module; dependency: IndexedDB and Canvas blobs, both optional-safe; concurrency: asynchronous saves can overlap with edits and reloads; state: stale/corrupt records or quota failures must not break startup.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use a versioned record schema, validate records before showing the dialog, serialize saves with a pending flag, skip the welcome baseline, delete a declined autosave, and test a full reload/restore in the headless browser.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: a versioned IndexedDB autosave stores layer PNG blobs plus name/dimensions/active layer/opacity/blend/lock/adjustments; saves are debounced, serialized and skipped during gestures, with a status indicator, quota/corrupt-record handling, a validated restore dialog, Start fresh, and no welcome-sample overwrite. Palette is 0.6.0 with 59 tests; the browser dogfood saves a 4-layer document, reloads the real page, clicks Restore and compares layer metadata/pixels exactly. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.state: npm test 59/59, dogfood passes autosave reload/restore, aikit check 4/4

checkpoints.description: Task 'palette-autosave' completed successfully.

[1/3] Add an invert flag to the single-shape marquee, even-odd clipping for paint/shapes/text/gradients/filters/clipboard, a document-boundary marquee cue, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+I and a panel button; disallow selected-pixel moves and crop-to-selection while inverted. [2/3] Add a pure Levels pixel transform with black point, white point and gamma, a filter-panel control, selection-aware application and undo. [3/3] Add unit/static/browser dogfood coverage, bump Palette to 0.7.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: Invert completes the selection workflow, and Levels is a standard tonal tool that adds real editing depth without new dependencies.
impact_assessment.benefits: Faster cutouts, even-odd selection clipping, tonal correction with selection support, and a site copy refreshed through the hash manifest.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: selection records gain an invert flag and the filter panel gains controls; dependency: Canvas even-odd clipping and pure pixel math; concurrency: none; state: inverted selections must not break copy/cut/filters and Levels must clamp black below white.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Normalise selection clones, centralise even-odd clipping in one helper, test Levels identity/clamping/gamma, dogfood inside/outside pixels for inverted paint and a Levels undo, and re-vendor only after the source suite is green.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: selections gain an invert flag with even-odd clipping across paint/shapes/text/gradients/filters/clipboard, a document-boundary cue, a panel button and Shift+I; selected-pixel moves and crop-to-selection are guarded while inverted. Levels (black/white/gamma) is a pure pixel transform wired into the filter panel, selection-aware and undoable. Palette is 0.7.0 with 62 tests and dogfood coverage for inverted brush clipping and Levels undo. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.state: npm test 62/62, dogfood passes invert/levels, aikit check 4/4
handoff.evidence: src/ui/paint.js clipToSelection, src/core/filters.js applyLevels, src/ui/editor.js invertSelection/applyLevelsFilter, scripts/dogfood.mjs.

checkpoints.description: Task 'palette-levels-invert' completed successfully.

[1/3] Add a pure constrainAspect helper and a crop-ratio selector (free, 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16) that constrains marquee drags and is testable. [2/3] Add a Flatten image command that composites visible layers with filters/blends into one layer, discards hidden layers and undoes in one step. [3/3] Add unit/static/browser dogfood coverage, bump Palette to 0.8.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: Crop ratios are a standard image workflow and Flatten gives users a clean one-layer result without leaving the editor.
impact_assessment.benefits: Predictable social/print crops, single-step flatten, no new dependencies, and a site copy refreshed through the hash manifest.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: crop options and layer commands change; dependency: Canvas compositing only; concurrency: none; state: aspect drags must clip correctly at document edges and flatten must preserve the visible composite while discarding hidden layers.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the aspect math in a pure tested helper, constrain only while dragging, use the existing compositeDocument path for flatten, and dogfood a 1:1 crop and flatten undo.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: a pure constrainAspect helper plus a crop-ratio selector (free, 1:1, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 9:16) constrains marquee drags and clamps at document edges; Flatten composites visible layers with filters/blends into one layer, discards hidden layers and undoes in one step. Palette is 0.8.0 with 64 tests and browser dogfood coverage for a square crop and flatten undo. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.state: npm test 64/64, dogfood passes square crop and flatten, aikit check 4/4
handoff.evidence: src/core/geometry.js constrainAspect, src/ui/editor.js flattenImage, index.html crop-aspect/btn-flatten, scripts/dogfood.mjs.

[1/3] Add a pure anchor-offset helper and a Canvas Size dialog (width, height, 3x3 anchor) that creates doc-sized layer canvases with the old art placed by anchor, clears selection and undoes in one step. [2/3] Add an export-scale control with normalized 0.25x-4x factors, scaled output dimensions in the dialog and a scaled composite in PNG/JPEG/WebP export. [3/3] Add unit/static/browser dogfood coverage (including PNG header dimensions), bump Palette to 0.9.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: Canvas Size and export scaling are standard document/export controls that are still missing and are self-contained to add.
impact_assessment.benefits: Border/extend workflows, social-resolution exports, predictable output dimensions, no new dependencies, and a hash-verified site copy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two dialogs and the export API change; dependency: Canvas drawImage only; concurrency: none; state: anchors must place art correctly for growth and shrink, and scaled exports must preserve aspect and alpha rules.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep anchor math pure and tested, constrain dimensions through boundedDimensions, test normalization, parse the exported PNG header in dogfood, and verify the iframe copy.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: a pure anchorOffset helper plus a Canvas Size dialog with nine anchors places existing art without scaling, clears selections and undoes in one step; export now supports 25%-400% scaling with normalized factors, scaled output dimensions in the dialog and scaled PNG/JPEG/WebP composites. Palette is 0.9.0 with 67 tests; the browser dogfood verifies a center-anchored 1600x1000 canvas, pixel shift and undo, plus a 50% PNG export with a 640x400 header. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.evidence: src/core/geometry.js anchorOffset, src/core/export.js normalizeExportScale, src/ui/editor.js applyCanvasSize/exportImage, index.html canvas dialog, scripts/dogfood.mjs.

[1/3] Add a pure histogram module (256-bin RGB/luma counts, transparent-pixel exclusion, percentile black/white range) with unit tests. [2/3] Draw the active-layer luminance histogram in the adjustments panel, refresh it after edits, show the auto range, and add a selection-aware Auto levels button using the existing Levels transform and undo. [3/3] Add static and browser dogfood coverage, bump Palette to 0.10.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: A histogram makes tonal editing legible and Auto levels gives users a one-click correction built on the histogram and existing Levels transform.
impact_assessment.benefits: Visible tonal distribution, fast auto correction, pure testable analysis, no new dependencies, and a hash-verified site refresh.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the adjustments panel gains a canvas and button; dependency: Canvas 2D only; concurrency: histogram refreshes must not run on every brush move; state: transparent pixels must not skew the range and an empty/neutral range must not break Auto levels.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Ignore transparent pixels, clamp/fallback empty ranges, debounce histogram drawing, test ramp/empty/all-alpha cases, and dogfood a changed image plus undo on a tonal layer.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: a pure histogram module counts visible RGB/luma bins, ignores transparent pixels and derives percentile black/white ranges with safe fallbacks; the adjustments panel draws a live luminance histogram, shows the range and adds a one-click Auto levels command using the Levels transform, selection-aware and undoable. Palette is 0.10.0 with 72 tests and dogfood coverage for histogram rendering plus Auto levels change/undo. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.state: npm test 72/72, dogfood passes histogram and auto levels, aikit check 4/4

checkpoints.description: Task 'palette-histogram' completed successfully.

[1/3] Add a pure findContentBounds helper (alpha threshold, transparent/empty cases) with unit tests. [2/3] Add a Transform layer dialog for scale X/Y, rotation and flips, applying the affine transform around the visible content bounds in one undoable canvas command and clearing stale selections. [3/3] Add static and browser dogfood coverage, bump Palette to 0.11.0, re-vendor into AegeanWorks and bump the site shell cache.

impact_assessment.why: Move is implemented but individual layers still cannot scale, rotate or flip; content-aware transform is the largest remaining layer gap.
impact_assessment.benefits: Full layer transforms, content-centred results, one-step undo, no new dependencies, and a hash-verified site refresh.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new dialog and layer command; dependency: Canvas affine transforms only; concurrency: none; state: transforms must not shift content unexpectedly, empty/locked layers must be refused, and stale selections must clear.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Compute bounds purely and test transparent borders, transform around those bounds, refuse empty/locked layers, dogfood scale/undo pixels, and re-vendor only after the source suite is green.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/3]-[3/3]: a pure findContentBounds helper with alpha-threshold tests supports content-centred layer transforms; a Transform dialog scales X/Y, rotates and flips around the visible content bounds in one undoable canvas command, clears stale selections, refuses empty/locked layers, and keeps document dimensions. Palette is 0.11.0 with 75 tests and dogfood coverage for a 50% scale (transparent corners, opaque centre) and undo. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; UI delivery review remains advisory).

handoff.state: npm test 75/75, dogfood passes layer transform and undo, aikit check 4/4

[1/4] Plan: bound resize and export output, make Auto levels use the active selection, add regression tests, bump to 0.11.1, then hand the vendored build to AegeanWorks.

impact_assessment.why: applyResize accepts 8192x8192 (64M pixels) past the 24M-pixel project cap, and export at 400% can exceed browser canvas limits and fail silently.
impact_assessment.benefits: Large-document edits and exports fail safely instead of crashing; selection-aware Auto levels matches the filtered region.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor exports stay zero-dependency; dependency: none; concurrency: AegeanWorks copies this tree; state: no persisted-format change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reuse boundedDimensions, add pure exportDimensions tests plus a dogfood cap check, and re-run npm test and dogfood before syncing.

checkpoints.description: Completed [1/4]: boundedDimensions now keeps the wide/tall aspect ratio while enforcing the 8192-axis and 24MP budget; resize, canvas-size and new-document inputs pass raw requested sizes through requestedDimension; exportDimensions caps scaled output and the dialog reports the effective percentage; Auto levels samples the active selection; added export/project regression tests and a dogfood resize-cap assertion. Evidence: 77/77 unit tests, dogfood pass with the 5000x5000 cap check, 4/4 project gates. checklists: passed (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets; G-001 equivalent not configured for Palette).
